In this petition, petitioners have sought for the following relief:-
"Wherefore, the petitioners / accused Nos.1 to 5 prays that this Hon'ble Court be
pleased to allow the petition and Nc: 2025:Khc:5896 quash the Fir registered
against the petitioners in Crime No.10/2023 of Kodigehalli Police Station for the
alleged offence punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 324, 405, 506 read with 149 of
Ipc and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, pending on the file of Hon'ble Vii
Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Bengaluru, in the interest of justice."

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners - accused Nos.1 to 5 and learned counsel for respondent No.2 - complainant have filed Joint Compromise Memo along with separate Affidavits of 1st petitioner and 2nd respondent duly signed by them and their respective counsel and the same is taken on record.

3. Petitioners - accused Nos.1 to 3, respondent No.2 and their counsel are physically present before the Court and they admit the contents of the Joint Compromise Memo and the Affidavits filed by them, which reads as under:-
"JOINT COMPROMISE MEMO It is submitted that, the petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 are the husband and wife they marriage have solemnized on 25.04.2018 some disputes arose and divorced by compromise on 18.01.2025 between the both the parties.

The 2nd respondent have lodged the police complaint before the 1st respondent and charge sheeted with NC: 2025:KHC:5896 CC No.19305/2023 pending before the VII Addl. Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru.

sentences.text: It is further submitted that the petitioners / accused have filed above criminal petition for quashing the offences under Sections 498(A), 323, 324, 504 and 506 r/w 149 IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
It is further submitted that, both the husband and wife in the above case compromised and the divorced on 18.01.2025.
Hence, this Memo for quashing the offences mentioned above by allowing this petition.

Wherefore, it is most humbly prayed that this Hon'ble Court be pleased to allow the petition by quashing the offences punishable under Sections 498(A), 323, 324, 504 and 506 r/w 149 IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, charge sheeted by the 1st respondent with CC No.19305/2023 the same is pending before VII Addl.
